name: pos
author: ServeOS
//electron: Pinned exactly, not a ^ range: npm workspaces hoist electron to the repo root, electron-builder only looks in apps/pos/node_modules, and its fallback of reading the declared version needs that version to be fixed (electron-builder#3984). A range here fails the packaging step with 'Cannot compute electron version'. Bump it deliberately.
//scripts: The tsc step in `build` is --noEmit on purpose: it is a typecheck gate, and vite-plugin-electron — not tsc — produces the dist-electron/{main,preload}.js that actually ship. Letting it emit wrote dist-electron/_offline/*.test.js, which vitest then collected as CommonJS test files and failed on (its exclude covers electron/_offline, not dist-electron/_offline), and shipped the parked offline tests inside the installer.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build && electron-builder --publish never

//build: Notes on the `build` block below — they live out here because electron-builder validates its config against a schema and rejects unknown keys, so a '//' inside it fails the build. (1) `files` ships the two bundles plus better-sqlite3: vite emits the renderer to dist/, vite-plugin-electron emits main+preload to dist-electron/. better-sqlite3 is the one runtime dependency that cannot be bundled — it is a native binding — so it must be collected, and npmRebuild must stay on to rebuild it against Electron's ABI rather than Node's. Both were off while the offline store was parked; the offline engine is now live and imports it, so shipping without it would leave the till unable to open its own event log. (2) `mac.identity: null` makes the unsigned build explicit rather than accidental — signing needs an Apple Developer cert, and without one macOS Gatekeeper requires right-click - Open on first launch. It is paired with the `afterPack` hook, which ad-hoc signs the bundle: skipping signing entirely leaves the Electron binary's own linker signature over a resource set packaging has changed, which fails `codesign --verify` and gets the download refused as 'damaged' — a wall right-click - Open does not get past. See build/adhoc-sign-mac.mjs. (3) `artifactName` overrides the default, which interpolates productName and would put a space in every filename — that breaks the unquoted glob the release workflow passes to `gh release create`, and turns every download URL into %20 soup.
